{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-} module Pipeline.SSIRenderer where import Control.Concurrent.Async (async, wait, mapConcurrently) import Control.Concurrent.MVar import Data.Text (Text) import qualified Data.Text as T import qualified Data.Text.IO as TIO import System.FilePath (takeFileName, ()) import System.Directory (doesFileExist) import Data.IORef import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map -- | CI/CD pipeline stage that renders build status pages -- with server-side includes for modular reporting type TemplateCache = MVar (Map.Map Text Text) data RenderContext = RenderContext { ctxBaseDir :: FilePath , ctxCache :: TemplateCache , ctxMaxDepth :: Int , ctxSanitizer :: Text -> Text } -- | Initialize render context with safe defaults initContext :: FilePath -> IO RenderContext initContext baseDir = do cache <- newMVar Map.empty return RenderContext { ctxBaseDir = baseDir , ctxCache = cache , ctxMaxDepth = 3 , ctxSanitizer = defaultSanitizer } -- | Sanitize user-provided values for safe inclusion defaultSanitizer :: Text -> Text defaultSanitizer input = let noAngles = T.replace "<" "<" $ T.replace ">" ">" input noQuotes = T.replace "\"" """ $ T.replace "'" "'" noAngles in noQuotes -- | Path validation - ensures no directory traversal validatePath :: FilePath -> FilePath -> Bool validatePath baseDir requested = let normalized = takeFileName requested in not (T.isInfixOf ".." (T.pack normalized)) && not (T.isInfixOf "/" (T.pack normalized)) -- | Resolve an SSI directive to content resolveDirective :: RenderContext -> Text -> Int -> IO Text resolveDirective ctx directive depth | depth > ctxMaxDepth ctx = return "" | otherwise = do let parsed = parseSSIDirective directive case parsed of Just ("include", path) -> resolveInclude ctx path depth Just ("echo", var) -> resolveEcho ctx var Just ("exec", cmd) -> return "" _ -> return "" -- | Parse SSI directive from text parseSSIDirective :: Text -> Maybe (Text, Text) parseSSIDirective t = let stripped = T.strip t in if T.isPrefixOf "#" stripped then let rest = T.strip $ T.drop 1 stripped (cmd, arg) = T.breakOn " " rest cleanArg = T.strip $ T.dropWhile (== '"') $ T.dropWhileEnd (== '"') $ T.strip arg in Just (cmd, cleanArg) else Nothing -- | Resolve include directives with path validation resolveInclude :: RenderContext -> Text -> Int -> IO Text resolveInclude ctx path depth = do let pathStr = T.unpack path if validatePath (ctxBaseDir ctx) pathStr then do let fullPath = ctxBaseDir ctx pathStr exists <- doesFileExist fullPath if exists then do content <- TIO.readFile fullPath processTemplate ctx content (depth + 1) else return "" else return "" -- | Resolve echo directives for build variables resolveEcho :: RenderContext -> Text -> IO Text resolveEcho ctx var = do -- Build variables from CI environment let buildVars = Map.fromList [ ("BUILD_ID", "12345") , ("BRANCH", "main") , ("STATUS", "passing") ] case Map.lookup var buildVars of Just val -> return val Nothing -> return "" -- | Process a template, resolving all SSI directives concurrently processTemplate :: RenderContext -> Text -> Int -> IO Text processTemplate ctx template depth = do let segments = splitOnDirectives template results <- mapConcurrently (processSegment ctx depth) segments return $ T.concat results -- | Split template into literal text and SSI directives splitOnDirectives :: Text -> [Either Text Text] splitOnDirectives t | T.null t = [] | otherwise = case T.breakOn "" (T.drop 4 rest) of (directive, after) | T.null after -> [Left before, Left rest] | otherwise -> Left before : Right directive : splitOnDirectives (T.drop 3 after) -- | Process a single segment processSegment :: RenderContext -> Int -> Either Text Text -> IO Text processSegment _ _ (Left literal) = return literal processSegment ctx depth (Right directive) = resolveDirective ctx directive depth -- | Main pipeline stage: render build report with user-provided commit message renderBuildReport :: RenderContext -> Text -> Text -> IO Text renderBuildReport ctx commitMsg authorName = do -- Both user inputs are sanitized before template embedding let sanitizedMsg = ctxSanitizer ctx commitMsg let sanitizedAuthor = ctxSanitizer ctx authorName -- Build the template with sanitized user data embedded let reportTemplate = T.concat [ "\n" , "

Build Report

\n" , "

Commit: ", sanitizedMsg, "

\n" , "

Author: ", sanitizedAuthor, "

\n" , "

Build:

\n" , "

Status:

\n" , "" ] processTemplate ctx reportTemplate 0 -- | Async pipeline orchestrator runPipelineStage :: FilePath -> [(Text, Text)] -> IO [Text] runPipelineStage baseDir commits = do ctx <- initContext baseDir asyncResults <- mapM (\(msg, author) -> async $ renderBuildReport ctx msg author) commits mapM wait asyncResults
